copyPanel.formula: Reflect over x-axis: (x, y) → (x, −y) | Reflect over y-axis: (x, y) → (−x, y)
steps: 1. Reflection across x-axis (horizontal line): y-coordinate changes sign, x stays same
2. Reflection across y-axis (vertical line): x-coordinate changes sign, y stays same
3. Both coordinates change sign when reflecting across both axes: (−x, −y)

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Treasure Map Mirror Twins
revealWordProblem.text: Captain Vega buries a chest at (-6, 4) on her treasure map. She wants to bury a decoy chest that is a mirror image of the real one, reflected across the y-axis, so raiders searching the wrong side will still find a clue. What are the coordinates of the decoy chest, and how far is it from the y-axis?
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Reflecting across the y-axis flips the sign of the x-coordinate and keeps the y-coordinate the same, so (-6, 4) becomes (6, 4). The original chest is |-6| = 6 units from the y-axis, and the decoy is also 6 units from the y-axis, just on the opposite side. The decoy chest is at (6, 4), exactly 6 units from the y-axis.

questions.stem: What is the reflection of (4, -3) over the x-axis?
questions.explanation: Reflecting over the x-axis changes the sign of the y-coordinate. The x stays the same (4), and the y changes from -3 to 3. The answer is (4, 3).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Reflecting over the x-axis changes the sign of the y-coordinate.
Both coordinates changed sign here, which is what two reflections would do. A single reflection over the x-axis leaves one coordinate untouched — decide which one.
The two numbers traded places. Reflecting never swaps x with y; it only changes a sign.
hints: Reflecting over the x-axis flips the point UP/DOWN — the left/right position doesn't move.
Keep the x-coordinate the same and switch the sign of the y-coordinate. Don't swap the numbers' order.
The point sits 3 units below the x-axis. Its mirror sits the same 3 units above, with the x still 4.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál es la reflexión de (4, -3) sobre el eje x?
questions.explanationEs: Reflejar sobre el eje x cambia el signo de la coordenada y. La x se mantiene igual (4) y la y pasa de -3 a 3. La respuesta es (4, 3).
hintsEs: Reflejar sobre el eje x voltea el punto ARRIBA/ABAJO: la posición izquierda/derecha no se mueve.
Conserva igual la coordenada x y cambia el signo de la coordenada y. No intercambies el orden de los números.
El punto está 3 unidades debajo del eje x. Su reflejo está esas mismas 3 unidades arriba, con la x todavía en 4.

questions.stem: What is the reflection of (-2, 6) over the y-axis?
questions.explanation: Reflecting over the y-axis changes the sign of the x-coordinate. x goes from -2 to 2, and y stays 6. The answer is (2, 6).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Reflecting over the y-axis changes the sign of the x-coordinate.
Both signs flipped in this point. A reflection over the y-axis changes only one coordinate — think about which one the vertical axis affects.
The coordinates were swapped instead of reflected. Keep x in the first position and y in the second, then change only a sign.
hints: Reflecting over the y-axis flips LEFT/RIGHT — the height stays the same.
Switch the sign of the x-coordinate and keep the y-coordinate 6 unchanged.
The point is 2 units left of the y-axis. Its mirror lands 2 units to the RIGHT, at the same height.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál es la reflexión de (-2, 6) sobre el eje y?
questions.explanationEs: Reflejar sobre el eje y cambia el signo de la coordenada x. La x pasa de -2 a 2 y la y se mantiene en 6. La respuesta es (2, 6).
hintsEs: Reflejar sobre el eje y voltea IZQUIERDA/DERECHA: la altura se queda igual.
Cambia el signo de la coordenada x y conserva la coordenada y en 6 sin cambios.
El punto está 2 unidades a la izquierda del eje y. Su reflejo cae 2 unidades a la DERECHA, a la misma altura.

questions.stem: Which point is on the y-axis?
questions.explanation: Points on the y-axis have x-coordinate = 0. (0, 5) is on the y-axis.
choiceFeedback: That point sits off to one side of the vertical axis. A point resting on the y-axis has an x-coordinate of exactly 0.
Not quite. Points on the y-axis have x-coordinate = ___.
You swapped the x and y—the first number is horizontal, second is vertical.
hints: Points on the y-axis have gone 0 units left or right — check the FIRST coordinate.
Scan each pair's x-coordinate (the first number). Only x = 0 keeps a point on the y-axis.
Read the first number in each pair. A point sits on the y-axis only when that number is 0.
questions.stemEs: ¿Qué punto está sobre el eje y?
questions.explanationEs: Los puntos sobre el eje y tienen la coordenada x = 0. El punto (0, 5) está sobre el eje y.
hintsEs: Los puntos sobre el eje y se han movido 0 unidades a la izquierda o a la derecha: revisa la PRIMERA coordenada.
Revisa la coordenada x (el primer número) de cada par. Solo x = 0 mantiene un punto sobre el eje y.
Prueba (0, 5): derecha 0, arriba 5 — nunca sales del eje vertical. Ahora revisa los primeros números de los demás.

reviewHighlights.formula: Reflect over x-axis: (x, y) → (x, −y) | Reflect over y-axis: (x, y) → (−x, y)
steps: 1. Reflection across x-axis (horizontal line): y-coordinate changes sign, x stays same
2. Reflection across y-axis (vertical line): x-coordinate changes sign, y stays same
3. Both coordinates change sign when reflecting across both axes: (−x, −y)
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Reflect Points Across Axes is flipping the sign of the wrong coordinate — changing the x-coordinate when reflecting over the x-axis, instead of the y-coordinate (or vice versa for the y-axis). For example, to reflect (3, -5) over the x-axis, a student might flip the x-coordinate and write (-3, -5), but reflecting over the x-axis only changes the sign of the y-coordinate: (3, -5) becomes (3, 5). Before you submit, ask: 'Did I flip the sign of the coordinate that matches the axis I'm reflecting over — y for the x-axis, x for the y-axis?'

level1.stem: (Lesson 7.5) Which ordered pair names a point 3 units right and 7 units up from the origin?
level1.explanation: The first coordinate is horizontal (right 3), the second is vertical (up 7). So (3, 7).
choiceFeedback: You swapped the x and y—the first number is horizontal, second is vertical.
Remember the x-coordinate tells you how far horizontally.
The first number is the horizontal (right/left) distance.
hints: Re-read the moves: 3 units right, then 7 units up. Which move comes first in an ordered pair?
An ordered pair is (x, y): x is the right/left distance, y is the up/down distance. Match each move to its slot.
Start at the origin and go right 3 — that 3 is the x, the first number. Now decide where the 'up 7' goes.
level1.stemEs: ¿Qué par ordenado nombra un punto que está 3 unidades a la derecha y 7 unidades hacia arriba desde el origen?
level1.explanationEs: La primera coordenada es horizontal (3 a la derecha) y la segunda es vertical (7 hacia arriba). Entonces (3, 7).
hintsEs: Vuelve a leer los movimientos: 3 unidades a la derecha y luego 7 unidades hacia arriba. ¿Cuál movimiento va primero en un par ordenado?
Un par ordenado es (x, y): x es la distancia derecha/izquierda y y es la distancia arriba/abajo. Une cada movimiento con su lugar.
Empieza en el origen y ve 3 a la derecha: ese 3 es la x, el primer número. Ahora decide dónde va el 'arriba 7'.

level1.stem: (Lesson 7.5) What are the coordinates of the origin?
level1.explanation: The origin is where the x-axis and y-axis cross, at (0, 0).
choiceFeedback: The origin is where both axes cross, where both values are zero.
Both coordinates at the origin are 0 — not mixed with 1.
The origin is where the two axes cross each other. At that crossing point, how far along is each axis? That tells you both coordinates.
hints: The origin is the exact spot where the x-axis and y-axis cross. Picture that crossing point.
Ask: how far right have you moved at the origin? How far up? Those two distances are the coordinates.
At the crossing point you haven't moved right at all, so x = 0. Now figure out the y-value the same way.
level1.explanationEs: El origen es donde se cruzan el eje x y el eje y, en (0, 0).
hintsEs: El origen es el punto exacto donde se cruzan el eje x y el eje y. Imagina ese cruce.
Pregunta: en el origen, ¿cuánto te has movido a la derecha? ¿Y hacia arriba? Esas dos distancias son las coordenadas.

level1.stem: (Lesson 7.6) What is the distance between (-4, 3) and (2, 3)?
level1.explanation: Both points have y = 3, so this is a horizontal distance. |2 - (-4)| = |2 + 4| = 6 units.
choiceFeedback: 2 is the difference of the sizes 4 and 2, but the points sit on OPPOSITE sides of zero. Count the units from -4 to 0, then from 0 to 2, and combine them.
It looks like you counted from -4 only as far as 0 and stopped there. The segment keeps going past the origin to x = 2, so there are more units to add on.
This is the distance you would get if the second point were at x = 4 instead of x = 2. Find 2 on the x-axis and count only that far.
hints: Both points have y = 3, so they sit on the same horizontal line — only the x-values differ.
Find the gap between x = -4 and x = 2. The path crosses zero, so add the two distances |-4| and |2|.
Count from -4 to 0 (that's 4 units), then from 0 to 2. Add the two parts together.
level1.explanationEs: Los dos puntos tienen y = 3, así que esta es una distancia horizontal. |2 - (-4)| = |2 + 4| = 6 unidades.
hintsEs: Ambos puntos tienen y = 3, así que están en la misma línea horizontal: solo cambian los valores de x.
Halla la distancia entre x = −4 y x = 2. El camino cruza el cero, así que suma las dos distancias |−4| y |2|.
Cuenta de −4 a 0 (son 4 unidades) y luego de 0 a 2. Suma las dos partes.

level2.stem: Point A is at (-3, 5). It is reflected over the x-axis to A', then A' is reflected over the y-axis to A''. What are the coordinates of A''?
level2.explanation: Over x-axis: (-3, 5) → (-3, -5). Then over y-axis: (-3, -5) → (3, -5). Both coordinates changed sign.
choiceFeedback: The first coordinate at origin is not 1.
One coordinate is correct, but check the other.
Both coordinates at origin are the same value — 0.
hints: Two flips happen in a row — do them one at a time, not both at once.
The first flip (x-axis) changes only the y sign. Then flip THAT result over the y-axis, changing only the x sign.
Step 1: (-3, 5) over the x-axis — keep the -3 and flip the 5. Carry that new point into the second reflection.
level2.stemEs: El punto A está en (-3, 5). Se refleja sobre el eje x hasta A', y luego A' se refleja sobre el eje y hasta A''. ¿Cuáles son las coordenadas de A''?
level2.explanationEs: Sobre el eje x: (-3, 5) → (-3, -5). Luego sobre el eje y: (-3, -5) → (3, -5). Ambas coordenadas cambiaron de signo.
hintsEs: Ocurren dos reflexiones seguidas: hazlas una a la vez, no las dos juntas.
La primera reflexión (eje x) cambia solo el signo de y. Luego refleja ESE resultado sobre el eje y, cambiando solo el signo de x.
Paso 1: (−3, 5) sobre el eje x — conserva el −3 y cambia el 5. Lleva ese punto nuevo a la segunda reflexión.

level2.stem: Captain Vega folds the map along the x-axis. A marker at (7, 2) lands on its mirror image. What are the new coordinates?
level2.explanation: Folding along (reflecting across) the x-axis flips the sign of the y-coordinate only. (7, 2) becomes (7, -2).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Folding along (reflecting across) the x-axis flips the sign of the y-coordinate only.
Both coordinates changed sign, which describes two folds rather than one. Folding along the x-axis changes only one of them.
The coordinates traded places. A reflection keeps x first and y second and only changes a sign.
level2.stemEs: La Capitana Vega dobla el mapa a lo largo del eje x. Un marcador en (7, 2) cae sobre su imagen reflejada. ¿Cuáles son las nuevas coordenadas?
level2.explanationEs: Doblar sobre el eje x (reflejar a través de él) cambia solo el signo de la coordenada y. El punto (7, 2) se convierte en (7, -2).
hints: Folding along an axis makes that axis the mirror line, and the point lands the same distance away on the other side.
The x-axis runs left and right, so the fold moves the point up or down — decide which coordinate that affects.
The marker is 2 units above the x-axis, so its image must be 2 units below it. The first coordinate does not move at all.
hintsEs: Doblar a lo largo de un eje convierte ese eje en la línea espejo, y el punto cae a la misma distancia del otro lado.
El eje x va de izquierda a derecha, así que el doblez mueve el punto hacia arriba o hacia abajo: decide qué coordenada se ve afectada.

level2.stem: A buried chest is marked at (-5, 3). Vega folds the map along the y-axis to find its mirror twin. Where is the twin?

level2.stemEs: Un cofre enterrado está marcado en (-5, 3). Vega dobla el mapa a lo largo del eje y para hallar su gemelo reflejado. ¿Dónde está el gemelo?

level2.stem: Vega reflects a palm-tree marker at (8, -6) across the x-axis. Which coordinate changes its sign?

choiceFeedback: Reflecting across the x-axis flips the point up-down. Does an up-down flip move the point left or right at all? That decides which coordinate changes.

level2.stemEs: Vega refleja un marcador de palmera en (8, -6) sobre el eje x. ¿Cuál coordenada cambia de signo?

The reflected triangle is congruent to the original — same side lengths and same angles — because a reflection is a mirror flip that turns the figure around without stretching or shrinking it.
level3.explanationEs: Refleja cada vértice sobre el eje y cambiando solo la coordenada x: A(1, 2) → A'(-1, 2), B(4, 2) → B'(-4, 2) y C(4, 6) → C'(-4, 6). El triángulo reflejado es congruente con el original —mismos lados y mismos ángulos— porque una reflexión es un volteo en espejo que gira la figura sin estirarla ni encogerla.
level3.promptEs: Un triángulo tiene vértices en A(1, 2), B(4, 2) y C(4, 6). Si reflejas todo el triángulo sobre el eje y, ¿cuáles son los vértices nuevos? ¿Qué observas sobre el tamaño y la forma del triángulo reflejado en comparación con el original?
hintsEs: Refleja cada vértice por separado sobre el eje y: solo cambian de signo las coordenadas x.
Aplica la regla a A(1, 2), B(4, 2) y C(4, 6) una a la vez. Luego compara las longitudes de los lados de ambos triángulos.
Empieza con A(1, 2): cambia el 1 por su opuesto y conserva el 2. Haz B y C igual y luego compara las figuras.

level3.stem: Captain Vega folds the map along the x-axis. A marker at (7, 2) lands on its mirror image. What are the new coordinates?
level3.explanation: Folding along (reflecting across) the x-axis flips the sign of the y-coordinate only. (7, 2) becomes (7, -2).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Folding along (reflecting across) the x-axis flips the sign of the y-coordinate only.
Both coordinates changed sign, which describes two folds rather than one. Folding along the x-axis changes only one of them.
The coordinates traded places. A reflection keeps x first and y second and only changes a sign.
level3.stemEs: La Capitana Vega dobla el mapa a lo largo del eje x. Un marcador en (7, 2) cae sobre su imagen reflejada. ¿Cuáles son las nuevas coordenadas?
level3.explanationEs: Doblar sobre el eje x (reflejar a través de él) cambia solo el signo de la coordenada y. El punto (7, 2) se convierte en (7, -2).
hints: Folding along an axis makes that axis the mirror line, and the point lands the same distance away on the other side.
The x-axis runs left and right, so the fold moves the point up or down — decide which coordinate that affects.
The marker is 2 units above the x-axis, so its image must be 2 units below it. The first coordinate does not move at all.
hintsEs: Doblar a lo largo de un eje convierte ese eje en la línea espejo, y el punto cae a la misma distancia del otro lado.
El eje x va de izquierda a derecha, así que el doblez mueve el punto hacia arriba o hacia abajo: decide qué coordenada se ve afectada.
El marcador está 2 unidades arriba del eje x, así que su imagen debe estar 2 unidades abajo. La primera coordenada no se mueve.

level3.stem: A buried chest is marked at (-5, 3). Vega folds the map along the y-axis to find its mirror twin. Where is the twin?
level3.explanation: Reflecting across the y-axis flips the sign of the x-coordinate only. (-5, 3) becomes (5, 3).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Reflecting across the y-axis flips the sign of the x-coordinate only.
Both signs changed in this point. Reflecting across the y-axis leaves one coordinate exactly as it was.
The coordinates were swapped and a sign was changed. Reflections never reorder the pair.
level3.stemEs: Un cofre enterrado está marcado en (-5, 3). Vega dobla el mapa a lo largo del eje y para hallar su gemelo reflejado. ¿Dónde está el gemelo?
level3.explanationEs: Reflejar sobre el eje y cambia solo el signo de la coordenada x. El punto (-5, 3) se convierte en (5, 3).
hints: The y-axis is the vertical line through the middle of the grid, and folding along it swings the point across from left to right.
Decide which coordinate tells you how far left or right a point sits — that is the one the fold changes.
The chest is 5 units to the left of the y-axis, so the twin must be 5 units to the right. The height stays exactly where it was.
hintsEs: El eje y es la recta vertical que pasa por el centro de la cuadrícula, y doblar a lo largo de él pasa el punto de izquierda a derecha.
Decide qué coordenada indica cuánto a la izquierda o a la derecha está un punto: esa es la que cambia con el doblez.
El cofre está 5 unidades a la izquierda del eje y, así que el gemelo debe estar 5 unidades a la derecha. La altura se queda igual.

level3.stem: Vega reflects a palm-tree marker at (8, -6) across the x-axis. Which coordinate changes its sign?
level3.explanation: Across the x-axis the rule is (x, y) -> (x, -y), so only the y-coordinate flips sign. (8, -6) becomes (8, 6).
choiceFeedback: Reflecting across the x-axis flips the point up-down. Does an up-down flip move the point left or right at all? That decides which coordinate changes.
Flipping both is what happens after two reflections, one across each axis. A single reflection touches only one coordinate.
If nothing changed, the point would land back on itself. A reflection across an axis always moves a point to the mirror side.
level3.stemEs: Vega refleja un marcador de palmera en (8, -6) sobre el eje x. ¿Cuál coordenada cambia de signo?
level3.explanationEs: Sobre el eje x la regla es (x, y) → (x, -y), así que solo la coordenada y cambia de signo. El punto (8, -6) se convierte en (8, 6).
hints: A mirror line only changes the direction you travel to cross it — everything parallel to that line stays put.
The x-axis is horizontal, so ask whether the point moves sideways or up and down when it reflects.
The marker sits 6 units below the x-axis and its image sits 6 units above. Look at which position in the ordered pair recorded that distance.
hintsEs: Una línea espejo solo cambia la dirección en que hay que cruzarla; todo lo paralelo a esa línea se queda igual.
El eje x es horizontal, así que pregúntate si el punto se mueve de lado o hacia arriba y abajo al reflejarse.
El marcador está 6 unidades debajo del eje x y su imagen queda 6 unidades arriba. Fíjate en qué posición del par ordenado registraba esa distancia.

tool.title: Reflect the triangle over the y-axis
tool.caption: Plot triangle A, B, C first, then its reflection A', B', C'. Reflecting over the y-axis flips the sign of x and leaves y alone.
